name: Berjaya Property Berhad
overview: Berjaya Property Berhad（前称Berjaya Land Berhad）今年完成公司名称变更，并推进多项新投资：拟以RM58.00 million认购Manjaran Sdn Bhd 29%股权，再以RM50.00 million收购其20%股权；同时拟成立合资企业进入汽车轮胎制造业务。此外，公司披露出售7-Eleven Malaysia Holdings Berhad股份，并有一家 dormant 子公司进行债权人自愿清盘。
overview_en: Berjaya Property Berhad (formerly Berjaya Land Berhad) completed its change of company name this year and pursued several new investments: proposed subscription of a 29% stake in Manjaran Sdn Bhd for RM58.00 million, followed by a proposed acquisition of an additional 20% stake for RM50.00 million; it also proposed a joint venture to undertake automotive tyre manufacturing in Malaysia.

segments.name: 物业发展与物业投资
segments.note: 公司拟通过认购及收购Manjaran Sdn Bhd股权进行投资，但公告未明确Manjaran所属业务板块。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to invest in Manjaran Sdn Bhd via subscription and acquisition of shares, but the announcements do not specify Manjaran's business segment.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以RM50.00 million向Citaglobal Berhad收购Manjaran Sdn Bhd 1.60 million股，占扩大后股本20%。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 1.60 million shares in Manjaran Sdn Bhd, representing 20% of the enlarged issued share capital, from Citaglobal Berhad for RM50.00 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以RM58.00 million认购Manjaran Sdn Bhd 2.32 million股新股，占扩大后股本29%。
actions.text_en: Proposed subscription of 2.32 million new shares in Manjaran Sdn Bhd, representing 29% of the enlarged issued share capital, for RM58.00 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面推进新业务投资、资产出售及子公司清盘。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company pursued new business investment, an asset disposal, and a subsidiary liquidation.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟成立合资企业，在马来西亚从事汽车轮胎制造业务。
actions.text_en: Proposed joint venture to undertake the automotive tyre manufacturing business in Malaysia.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公告出售7-Eleven Malaysia Holdings Berhad的股份。
actions.text_en: Announced the disposal of shares in 7-Eleven Malaysia Holdings Berhad.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资 dormant 子公司Amat Muhibah Sdn Bhd根据《2016年公司法》第449条启动债权人自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned dormant subsidiary Amat Muhibah Sdn Bhd commenced creditors' voluntary liquidation pursuant to Section 449 of the Companies Act 2016.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟通过合资企业进入汽车轮胎制造业务，该业务不在现有业务线中。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to enter the automotive tyre manufacturing business through a joint venture, which is not among the existing business lines.
